steps.text:
The change that caused it was commit **5ad0b3e**, "Lower ledger client timeout from 2s to 200ms" (PR #412 in acme/payments-worker). It was written by **sam.r**, who also triggered the deployment.

- **Deployment:** dep-4815 put payments-worker (svc-payworker) v1.9.3 into production at 2026-10-23T16:40:27Z. It was rolled back automatically because the error rate stayed above the 5% SLO for 10 minutes.
- **The change:** In `src/ledger/client.rs`, the ledger client timeout went from `Duration::from_secs(2)` to `Duration::from_millis(200)`.
- **Evidence:** The deployment's error logs show "ledger-service call timed out after 200ms (retry budget exhausted)" at 16:44:02Z. That matches the new timeout exactly.

One caveat: I tried to list every commit between the previous deploy (3e1f2d0) and 5ad0b3e, but the version control tool returned "cannot compare 3e1f2d0..5ad0b3e". So I can't rule out other commits in that range. Still, the 200ms timeout errors point directly to this change.
